result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both pages sort the invoices by due date, leave out paid ones, label overdue rows in words, and show the $750.00 still owed on the part-paid invoice. A has the edge: it gives the currency once in the headers, shows the $400.00 received in its own column, and adds a total-owed row. B repeats the $ sign on every row and tucks the payment received into a subtitle line. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both pages list the same six unpaid invoices with the most overdue first. Both label overdue rows in words and correctly show $750.00 still owed on #1044. B is slightly better: it states the currency once in the column headers, gives the $400.00 received its own column and adds a total row, while A repeats the $ sign in every row. B's overdue labels also add an icon, so they rely less on color.
